title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 6: the ant and the sluggard, the seven things Yahweh hates, and the warning against adultery.

questions.text: What should the son do if he has become collateral for his neighbor?
questions.explanation: He must deliver himself: go, humble himself, and press his plea with his neighbor.

answers.text: Pay back his neighbor double what he pledged for him
Flee from the city until his neighbor forgets the pledge
Go, humble himself, and press his plea with his neighbor
Wait patiently at home for seven days and seven nights

questions.text: Which creature is the sluggard told to go to and consider?
questions.explanation: The sluggard is told: "Go to the ant... consider her ways, and be wise."

questions.text: What does the ant do, even though she has no chief, overseer, or ruler?
questions.explanation: Without any ruler, the ant provides her bread in the summer and gathers her food in the harvest.

answers.text: She builds her house on a rock
She provides her bread in the summer
She leads all the other ants

questions.text: After "a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep", how will poverty come?
questions.explanation: Poverty will come as a robber, and scarcity as an armed man.

questions.text: How does the worthless person signal, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: He winks with his eyes, signals with his feet, and motions with his fingers.

answers.text: He winks with his eyes, signals with his feet, and motions with his fingers
He shouts his plans aloud in the streets and in the public squares
He blows a loud trumpet before him wherever he goes about
He sends secret letters to his friends throughout the city

questions.text: How many things does this chapter say are an abomination to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: There are six things which Yahweh hates, yes, seven which are an abomination to him.

questions.text: Which of these is listed among the things Yahweh hates?
questions.explanation: The list includes arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood, a false witness, and he who sows discord among brothers.

questions.text: What will your father's commandment and mother's teaching do when you sleep?
questions.explanation: When you walk, it will lead you; when you sleep, it will watch over you; and when you awake, it will talk with you.

questions.text: What question does the chapter ask to show that going in to a neighbor's wife brings punishment?
questions.explanation: It asks whether a man can scoop fire into his lap and his clothes not be burned; so whoever touches his neighbor's wife will not be unpunished.

answers.text: "Can a leopard change his spots, or wash away his marks?"
"Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?"
"Can a man hide himself in darkness where no one sees him?"
"Can two walk together along the way unless they have agreed?"

questions.text: If a thief who stole because he was hungry is found, how much shall he restore?
questions.explanation: If he is found, he shall restore seven times; he shall give all the wealth of his house.
